steps.name: live-poke-delivers-wake-via-ntfy
steps.cmd: bash -c 'h=$(head -c 10 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr "+/" "-_" | tr -d "="); code=$(curl -sS -m 10 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "content-type: application/json" -d "{\"to\":\"$h\"}" https://poke.getnowhere.im/poke); echo "poke=$code"; [ "$code" = 202 ] || exit 1; sleep 2; curl -fsS -m 10 "https://ntfy.getnowhere.im/gnh-$h/json?poll=1&since=60s"'

steps.name: live-gateway-cors-preflight
steps.cmd: curl -sS -m 10 -i -X OPTIONS https://poke.getnowhere.im/register -H 'Origin: null' -H 'Access-Control-Request-Method: POST' -H 'Access-Control-Request-Headers: content-type'
